records.description: 【共读《黄帝内经》】AI助力共读计划·发刊词 今天，是一个特别的起点——我正式启动「AI助力·《黄帝内经》共读精进计划」，从此刻出发，以微光聚星河，邀你一同解锁这部穿越千年的智慧宝典，在经典中修身、在共学中精进。 提起《黄帝内经》，我们或许都听过它的盛名：它是中华传统医学的源头活水，是古人安身养心的智慧结晶，更是一部涵盖生命哲学、养生之道、处世智慧的百科全书。但这份厚重，也让许多人望而却步——文言文的晦涩难懂、条文的深奥玄妙、独自阅读的枯燥乏力，让这部经典的智慧，难以真正走进我们的日常。 今日启航，不负时光，不负初心。诚邀各位伙伴，共赴这场跨越千年的智慧之约，一同在《黄帝内经》的滋养中，慢慢沉淀、共同成长，奔赴更通透、更健康、更丰盈的自己✨

records.name: DOTmatian

Enterprise users get brand protection with typosquat detection and full domain reconnaissance.

records.name: ScholarVault
records.tagline: Verify academic conferences before you submit your research
records.description: India's first real-time academic conference verification platform. records.name: Campaign Failure Predictor

records.description: Most campaigns fail for the same reasons. Wrong ICP. Vague goal. Mismatched channel. Weak post-click. No measurement. Campaign Failure Predictor asks 10 questions and scores your failure risk from 0 to 100. No login. No email. No upsell. Just an honest score and the specific areas that need fixing. 60 seconds. Free.

records.name: WordReels
records.tagline: Spin letter reels to solve the daily 5-letter word puzzle
records.description: WordReels is a free daily word game with a unique spinning reel mechanic. Spin letter reels to form a hidden 5-letter word in 6 attempts. A new puzzle drops every day at midnight. Beyond the daily challenge, practice mode offers endless puzzles at 4, 5, or 6-letter difficulty. Find bonus words to earn coins for hints. No ads, no paywalls — just word puzzles. Works on any device, no app download needed.

records.name: pinza.ai

records.description: pinza.ai offers fully managed OpenClaw AI assistants for Spanish freelancers and SMEs. No technical setup required. From €19.99/month.

records.name: The Startup Video Press Release Builder

records.description: The Startup Video Press Release builder SaaS platform aim to help new businesses to overcome invisibility. More than 500000 businesses registered in the USA every month according government statistics and Forbes Magazine and 90% of them needs immidiate advertising. This interructive tool help to create press kits including articles for traditional and social media, audio jingles for radio and podcast advertising, narrated video like talking business cards and more.

records.name: MeerSync – Know when integrations break
records.tagline: Real-time alerts when your integrations silently fail
records.description: Silent failures kill integrations. A webhook fails, an ETL job stops — and no one notices until a user complains. MeerSync helps developers monitor integrations between services. Track events from webhooks, background jobs, ETL pipelines and APIs in one place. Detect failures instantly, retry events with one click and keep your integrations reliable. Built for engineering teams running Odoo, Shopify, microservices or any event-driven pipeline.

records.tagline: Your OpenClaw’s Personal Stock Research Agent
records.description: Ask stock and equity questions directly in OpenClaw and get research-backed answers powered by Alphagent. From valuation and earnings to near-term risks and market context, this plugin gives OpenClaw a dedicated financial research specialist for public equities.

records.name: Bayan Flow (0.3.0)

records.description: Bayan Flow: Learn algorithms with clarity through interactive step-by-step animations. Visualize sorting algorithms (Bubble, Quick, Merge) and pathfinding algorithms (BFS, Dijkstra, A*) with real-time complexity analysis. Bayan (بيان) means clarity in Arabic.

records.name: GenSparx
records.tagline: "Send a message. Your AI handles the rest."
records.description: GenSparx is an open-source AI automation framework that runs locally on your machine. Connect WhatsApp, Telegram, and messaging apps to autonomously execute real-world digital tasks email, scheduling, browser control, and more.

records.name: Lightning Rod
records.tagline: Turn real-world data into training datasets fast
records.description: Lightning Rod SDK turns real-world data — like news, filings, or your own documents — into verified, production-ready training datasets in hours using just a few lines of Python. Skip manual labeling and synthetic guesswork.

records.name: Kira 4.0
records.tagline: Turn your friends into shareable content
records.description: Kira 4.0 brings video and music into the same creative flow as our image editor. Animate a friend's photo, drop an AI soundtrack, change their hairstyle before anyone notices. No prompts, no downloads, no experience needed. Just pick something, make it, and share the joy.

records.name: ActiveStat
records.tagline: Performance. Simplified.
records.description: Your Mac is powerful, but understanding its performance shouldn’t require opening heavy system tools. ActiveStat provides high-fidelity telemetry for CPU, memory, disk, network activity, and energy impact in a calm, minimal interface. It interprets system signals like thermal state, sustained load, and memory pressure so you can understand what’s happening instantly. Built for Apple Silicon. Private by design.

records.name: Xeder
records.tagline: Your X.com feed as a podcast
records.description: Xeder is a Chrome extension that reads your X/Twitter timeline aloud using natural text-to-speech. Open X, press play, and your feed becomes audio. Listen while working, cooking, or commuting. Tweets are short, standalone, text-first. They work perfectly as audio. Like bite-sized podcast episodes from people you actually follow. Natural voices, playback controls, speed adjustment, automatic ad filtering, and scroll sync. Built by a UX designer using AI. $4.99 one-time.

records.name: Habit Tracker - HabitGate
records.tagline: Build habits. Quit vices. 100% Private. No accounts.
records.description: HabitGate: Build Good Habits. Quit Bad Ones. 100% Private. Stop being the product. HabitGate is an account-free sanctuary for self-mastery. While others track your data, we protect your progress. Why it stands out: • Dual Logic: Track habits to build AND vices to quit in one dashboard. • Quality Over Quantity: Unique 1–5 rating system to track your discipline, not just streaks. • Total Privacy: No accounts. No cloud. Local-first. • Real-Life Ready: Built-in rest days & pause features.

records.name: Pick AI Videos
records.tagline: Pick the best AI video model by quality, cost, and speed
records.description: Pick AI Videos is an AI-powered platform that recommends the best video model based on your prompt and budget. Access all models through a unified dashboard and a single credit system, eliminating multiple subscriptions and trial-and-error. Built for creators and marketers who want professional AI videos without managing separate accounts.

It also tracks focus time and suggests short stretch breaks to reduce fatigue and help desk workers maintain healthier, more productive work habits.

A Chrome extension that scans directly inside the Etsy editor. 500+ trademark database. And an appeal letter generator for listings that have already been flagged. FSRS-5 spaced repetition under the hood. Free to start.

records.name: FounderDistro
records.tagline: One URL → a week of content for LinkedIn & X
records.description: FounderDistro turns any URL into a full week of platform-specific content for LinkedIn and X — automatically. Paste a link to your product, article, or launch. FounderDistro pulls trending signals, analyzes what's performing in your niche, and generates ready-to-post content: LinkedIn carousels, thought-leadership posts, X threads, and short hooks. Unlike generic AI writers, it learns your voice and adapts to real-time trends — so your content stays relevant, not just generated.

records.name: PromoGoat
records.tagline: Stop guessing, start planning.
records.description: Plan smarter ad campaigns with PromoGoat. AI-powered campaign planning that helps you decide where to advertise, how to split your budget, and what creative to run.

Just small groups (max 12) showing up together. Because 847 connections online doesn't mean you have someone to grab dinner with.

No dashboards. No clicking through Ads Manager for hours. Just tell the agent what you want done.

records.description: Most photos look ordinary when shared online. Doodle Photo automatically turns them into bright, chaotic, attention-grabbing images. Just upload a photo — the bot analyzes the scene and instantly adds expressive doodles, arrows, captions, and annotations that match the moment. In seconds you get a colorful, funny, slightly crazy version of your photo that’s perfect for social media, memes, and chats.

records.name: LiveNote
records.tagline: Write notes on your lock screen so you never forget
records.description: LiveNote puts your notes where you’ll actually see them — your Lock Screen. Most note apps store things away. LiveNote keeps them visible. Write a note once, and it stays on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island — so you don’t forget. No need to open an app. Just turn on your screen and check instantly. Built for: - People who forget notes - Lock Screen power users - Anyone who wants always-visible tasks

records.name: AI SaaS Landing Page Template
records.tagline: Premium Framer template for high-converting AI startups
records.description: Stop wasting hours on landing page design. Our AI-Powered SaaS Landing Page template for Framer allows startup founders to launch professional, high-converting pages in minutes. Featuring a sleek dark-mode aesthetic, fully customizable AI-generated sections, and built-in conversion tracking layouts. It’s not just a template; it’s a complete launch system designed to turn visitors into users. Perfect for SaaS, AI tools, and digital products. Ship faster, grow better.

records.name: Ensemble
records.tagline: Beautiful screenwriting +AI shot lists, built to collaborate
records.description: Ensemble is a beautifully crafted, modern screenplay writing software for writers, filmmakers, and collaborators. Write industry-standard screenplays, collaborate in real time, generate AI-assisted shot lists, and securely share scripts with optional password protection.

records.name: Papyr
records.tagline: A private document scanner with no ads or subscriptions
records.description: Papyr is a document scanner for iPhone that doesn't track you, show ads, or charge a subscription. Auto edge detection, OCR with full-text search, and PDF export. Everything runs locally. Zero third-party SDKs. Zero network requests. Apple's privacy label: "Data Not Collected." Free: unlimited scans, OCR, search, PDF export. Pro ($9.99 once): folders, batch scan, password-protected PDFs.

records.name: Angy
records.tagline: Multi‑agent pipelines w/ AI‑driven scheduling + safety check
records.description: Angy is an open-source fleet manager and IDE for Claude Code, Anthropic API and Gemini API. Single-agent tools often generate code that fails at integration. Angy fixes this by orchestrating a deterministic multi-phase pipeline (Plan → Build → Test) featuring an adversarial Counterpart agent that strictly verifies all code. Using Git worktree isolation, multiple agents can build on your repo in parallel without branch conflicts.

records.name: FamilyAgent
records.tagline: AI-powered family coordination — no nagging required
records.description: FamilyAgent turns natural language into coordinated family action. Speak or type to delegate tasks, set reminders in a family member's cloned voice, and manage shared calendars, shopping lists, and documents — all in one place. Includes a Companion Mode for elderly users and elder care monitoring.

records.name: VigiLoc
records.tagline: Instant regulatory audits for French real estate.
records.description: VigiLoc provides instant regulatory audits for French real estate. Stop guessing and start securing your investment. Just enter any French address to instantly check local compliance: Rent Control zones, Energy Performance (DPE) bans, Rent Freezes for "passoires thermiques," and high-demand "Zones Tendues." Our algorithm scans official data to help investors and pros avoid legal traps. 🚀 V1 is live: Get your first full audit for free (no credit card required).

records.name: Circadian Energy
records.tagline: Visualize your personalized energy curve without stress
records.description: Circadian helps you sync your life with your biological rhythm. Using HealthKit data, it calculates a personalized energy curve to show you exactly when to focus and when to rest. Unlike other trackers, I aimed to avoid anxiety-inducing metrics like sleep debt and cut out annoying notifications. Get a clear view of your productivity windows and optimize your day based on your body’s natural clock. Experience science-based tracking designed for clarity and focus.

records.name: Prove It
records.tagline: Stop doom-scrolling. Prove your work.
records.description: Prove It is the productivity app that blocks distractions until you prove the work is done with AI verifiers. Build discipline, maintain streaks, and stay focused.

records.name: Slash
records.tagline: A modern software for writing screenplays online
records.description: Slash Studios is a modern screenwriting software designed for filmmakers and screenwriters. Write, organize, and structure your screenplays easily with a clean, distraction-free interface. Whether you're writing a short film, a series, or a feature film, Slash helps you focus on what matters most: telling your story. Our goal is to make screenwriting simple and accessible to everyone.

records.name: Online Browser Game
records.tagline: Trust no one. Find the imposter
records.description: Imposter Challenge Mode is a multiplayer browser game based on intelligence and challenge. It features multiple game modes, supports Arabic and English, and runs online instantly with no download required.
